dedupe_keys.name: temporal network of mobile phone users in changchun

description: This Figshare collection publishes temporal mobile-phone networks for Changchun Municipality in Northeast China, assembled by the Changchun research team. Three deposited components provide day-labelled temporal records, mobility links and distances between locations. The mobility component identifies origin, destination and weight; the distance component supplies separations between network locations. Files are text tables, accessible without registration under CC BY 4.0, and the collection was published in April 2018. The own landing metadata does not state a complete calendar observation window or a uniform within-day interval. Location identifiers and distances should not be assumed to provide precise geographic coordinates. There is also a naming discrepancy: the temporal item's current file list uses mobility-style names, which users should resolve against the descriptor before combining tables. The weighted links can inform population movement and contact-network assumptions in transport or emergency-response simulations. They complement data-telecom-italia-big-data-challenge, which describes mobile activity for different cities and an operator-specific sampling process.
